summary: Frontend-only testing of the new 'Listen First' audio narration feature across all 5 guided-journey steps. All 5 mp3 assets are served correctly (HTTP 200, Content-Type: audio/mpeg, ~1.1MB each). ListenFirstButton renders and functions correctly on all 5 pages (safety-assessment, comm-style, child-goals, reflection Write tab, readiness). Play/Pause/Resume cycles work, progress advances, currentTime freezes on pause and resumes from paused position on next click. Unmount cleanup verified — audio stops when navigating away. All 4 wizard PUT regressions pass (PUT /mediation/child-goals, /mediation/comm-style, /mediation/reflection, /mediation/readiness all returned 200). Safety Assessment intro card still shows the Start button and the HighConcernOverlay still triggers when a high-concern S1 question is answered Yes.

/prep/communication (prefix 'comm-style-.note: Review request wrote '/prep/comm-style' but actual route is '/prep/communication' (see App.js line 147). Panel works on the real route.

unmount_pause_cleanup.detail: Started playback on /prep/child-goals (currentTime=1.46s, paused=false), navigated to /dashboard. On /dashboard: no <audio> element present at all (component fully unmounted) and no audio still playing.

critical_code_review_comments: Route naming inconsistency (not a bug, minor documentation issue): The review request refers to the Communication Style page as '/prep/comm-style', but the actual route in App.js is '/prep/communication'. The data-testid prefix on the ListenFirstButton uses 'comm-style-listen' which does not match the route. Consider aligning naming to reduce future confusion — either rename the route to '/prep/comm-style' or rename the testid prefix to 'communication-listen'.

ListenFirstButton.jsx (line 66-80): the async toggle() is missing error state clearing. If a first attempt sets error='Tap play again if audio didn't start.', a subsequent successful play does not clear that message. Consider setError(null) at the top of toggle() so stale error UI disappears on successful play.

ListenFirstButton.jsx: the audio element is not marked with any preload='none' fallback — 5 * ~1.1MB assets load metadata on every page visit. This is fine but could be optimized to preload='none' with a click-to-load handshake if page weight ever becomes a concern.

Only one audio can meaningfully play at a time site-wide, but there is no global coordination — if a future page ever mounts two ListenFirstButtons simultaneously (e.g., a preview widget), both could play. Currently no page does this, so not a bug today.
action_items: OPTIONAL: Update the review-request-level path from '/prep/comm-style' to '/prep/communication' in future task notes, OR update the actual route in App.js so it matches the naming convention.
OPTIONAL: Clear the transient error string in ListenFirstButton.toggle() on a successful subsequent play.

success_rate.frontend: 100% — all 5 audio panels play/pause/resume, all 4 wizard PUTs return 200, Safety Assessment intro + Start button + HighConcernOverlay all still working
